map.→ 打开折叠纸盒结构参数工具: -> Open the folding carton structure parameter tool
map.以「外尺寸 200×150×100 mm、纸板厚 3 mm，算内尺寸与容积」为例: Taking "outer dimensions 200×150×100 mm with 3 mm board, calculate the inner dimensions and volume" as an example
map.以「目标容积 1000 mL、长宽比 2、高宽比 1.5、纸板厚 2 mm，反推: Taking "target volume 1000 mL, length-to-width ratio 2, width-to-height ratio 1.5, board thickness 2 mm, back out the dimensions" as an example
map.内尺寸为什么等于外尺寸减两倍厚度？: Why is the inner dimension the outer dimension minus twice the thickness?
map.包装结构设计时确认管式折叠盒的压痕线数与拼版展开尺寸，辅助绘制刀模图。: When designing packaging structure, confirm the number of score lines and the flattened die-cut size of a tube-folded carton to help draw the die line drawing.
map.压痕线数 7 条怎么来的？: Where does the 7 score lines figure come from?
map.已知外尺寸与纸板厚度，反推内尺寸与可装容积，确认能否装下产品及缓冲材料。: Given the outer dimensions and board thickness, back out the inner dimensions and usable volume to confirm the product and cushioning fit.
map.折叠纸盒结构参数 使用指南: Folding carton structure parameter user guide
map.标准管式折叠盒（如牙膏盒）在坯料上有 1 条粘口边 + 4 条形成侧壁的纵向压痕: A standard tube-folded carton (such as a toothpaste box) has 1 glue seam on the blank plus 4 longitudinal creases forming the side walls plus 2 transverse creases at the ends, 7 in total, which determines the folding method. Special structures (such as auto-lock bottoms) have more creases.
map.纸板有六个面，任一方向的内空都少了两侧各一个板厚，所以内尺寸=外尺寸-2×厚度。: A carton has six faces, and the inner space is short by one board thickness on each side in any direction, so inner dimension = outer dimension − 2×thickness. Volume must use the inner dimensions to reflect the real space; using outer dimensions overestimates by about (2×thickness/outer dimension)³.
map.给定目标容积，按长宽比、高宽比反算推荐内尺寸，再算外尺寸与刀模展开尺寸。: Given a target volume, back out the recommended inner dimensions from the length-to-width and width-to-height ratios, then compute the outer dimensions and flattened die-cut size.
map.输入纸盒内尺寸（长/宽/高）或目标容积，工具计算折叠纸盒的压痕线位置、拼版展开尺: Enter the box inner dimensions (length/width/height) or a target volume, and the tool computes crease positions, the flattened layout size and the tuck structure parameters of the folding carton, assisting packaging structure design and die drawing while reducing trial mould waste.
